description: Mint a SINGLE-USE, expiring, NO-LOGIN employer preview link for one published course version. The employer sees the course the way assigned workers see it — never answers, rubrics or grading keys. Omit courseVersionId for the current published version. The URL is returned ONLY here (and on a same-key retry while unopened); the first open uses it up, a second open is refused. Every mint, open and revoke is audited. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_create_employer_preview_link
